name: El Quintos
description: El Quintos was a street gang based in the Williamsburg area of Brooklyn, with territory spanning into Bushwick, Bedford-Stuyvesant, Red Hook, and East New York. The gang was active from at least the early 1950s through at least 1961. Documented incidents include the 1953 killing of member Eleazar Collins by El Mambo Reys, the 1954 shotgun killing of Jesse Lipscombe by Raymond Holley, and the 1961 beating death of Black Diamonds member Solomon Valle by Louis Ressey.
